caption: The drawing shows two main objects against a plain, light beige background. On the left, there is a sheath that is primarily brown with detailed patterns etched into the material. The top and bottom of the sheath are fitted with metallic silver-colored caps adorned with engraved designs, and there is a chain and loop attached to the top cap, also rendered in a silver-gray color. On the right, there is a knife with a long, silver-colored blade. The knife handle is mostly black with two thin, gold bands and a section of red near the middle, plus a silver cap at the front engraved with a similar design to those on the sheath. The objects are positioned diagonally on the page and are separated from each other, with the sheath upright and slightly tilted to the left, and the knife angled downward to the right. Handwritten text appears lightly at the bottom edges of the image.
title: Trapper's Hunting Knife
